name: Airtable
tagline: A database-and-apps platform where AI helps you build apps and automate work on your data.
about: Airtable is a spreadsheet-like database for teams. AI can build an app or automation from a description and work on the records you store.
pros: A database that non-developers can shape.
AI can build an app or automation from a description.
cons: Record and automation limits on lower plans.
Per-seat pricing gets expensive for larger teams.
